parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the timed schedule.

parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the timed schedule. Valid values:

- **true**: Enables the timed schedule.

- **false**: Disables the timed schedule.

parameters.name: FlowName
parameters.description: The name of the workflow to which the timed schedule is attached.

parameters.name: Payload
parameters.description: The trigger message of the timed schedule. The message must be in the JSON format.

parameters.name: ScheduleName
parameters.description:
The name of the timed schedule. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can contain letters (a-z and A-Z), digits (0-9), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

- It must start with a letter or an underscore (\_).

- It is case-sensitive.

- It must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
